mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 60% of the cases when FEDFUNDS is below 1%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the cases when UNRATE is above 8%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing non-farm payroll employment indicates a strong labor market, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not show a positive trend following increasing PAYEMS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production may indicate supply chain issues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of the cases when INDPRO is below 97, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment and decreasing payroll employment together indicate a weakening labor market, which may lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by 0.5% and PAYEMS decreases by 0.5% in one month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of the cases when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in real GDP indicates a strong economy, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the cases when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2%, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising consumer price index (CPI) with low federal funds rate may indicate inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
regime_hint: low interest rate and inflationary regime
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 35% of the cases when both conditions are met, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing retail sales suggest strong consumer demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 returns do not show a positive trend following RSAFS growth above 5%, the hypothesis is rejected.
